svg.title: The motor feedback loop and where my coursework sits in it
svg.desc: Block diagram of a motor feedback loop: reference, controller, PWM or DAC, power stage, motor, load, sensors, signal conditioning, ADC or encoder interface, estimator. Each block is tagged with the KTH course that implemented it on hardware (MF2007, MF2103, MF2043) or in simulation (MF2030).
